skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the basics of international marketing
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp the essence of international marketing, planning and strategic processes, environmental analysis, customer behavior, resource management, and execution of marketing activities.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing environmental factors and marketing resources
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the impact of political, legal, economic, cultural, and social environments on marketing activities.
Evaluate the feasibility of entering international markets and select appropriate market entry strategies.
Create comprehensive international marketing plans for specific products or brands.
Execute and manage marketing strategies in international markets.
Adjust marketing strategies to fit different international business environments.
Work effectively in teams, contribute to group discussions, and support team members.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve marketing problems in international contexts.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and integrate knowledge from various disciplines.
